title: 10/10 recommended for a real local experience
text:

He really knows the in-and-outs of the city and I honestly think he took us to the coolest bars in town. It’s definitely not the type of tour that takes you to overrated touristy areas that overcharge your drinks.

title: UNIQUE and AUTHENTIC experience
text:
I had the pleasure of participating in a truly unique bar tour unlike any other similar experience I have ever had. 
From the very first moment we met, Alessandro was extremely helpful. 
He was able to involve the whole group with his infectious energy taking us to a series of characteristic bars, far from the usual common and commercial premises.
Alessandro led us through the hidden streets of the city, making us discover unexpected corners and surprising murals.
It was more than just a night out. A journey through the culture and soul of the city, led by a passionate and competent person.

title: Authentic Barcelona
text:
Alessandro is an exceptional host, taking us to authentic Barcelona, far from the tourist tours, to places we would not have visited otherwise. 
Walking through the Raval, Alessandro told us anecdotes about the neighborhood and took us to historic Catalan clubs and punk rock bars. Recommended experience!
